name: Ledger
description: Photograph an invoice. Know in seconds if a store is actually stocked.
concept: Brackets closing on three stock rows. The brackets bound and verify; the rows are what was counted. The animated cut plays the same idea in sequence: the brackets close (scan), then the rows grow left to right (count).

palette.note: Two colours: black and blue, on white. BLUE IS THE ACCENT AND IS USED FOR THE BRACKETS ONLY - the rows stay black (white on the inverse cuts). On dark grounds use blue_on_dark #5B82FF instead: the white-ground blue #1B4DFF goes muddy against near-black and the mark loses its shape. That split is deliberate and so is the 16px behaviour: a single blue row disappears at small sizes, and a fully blue mark loses the contrast between brackets and rows. The 38% opacity on the middle row is part of the mark and must not be restyled.

typography.wordmark: Archivo SemiBold (600), SIL Open Font License
typography.outlines: The wordmark ships as outlines in logo/wordmark.path and is embedded as a <path> in the lockups, so it never depends on a font being installed. Do not re-typeset it in live text.
typography.ui: For supporting text, Archivo where available, otherwise a system sans stack.

usage.default: Use the lockup (mark + wordmark) wherever there is room. Use the bare mark only where the name is already present or space is tight.
usage.on_dark: Switch to the -inverse files: rows and wordmark flip to white and the brackets lift to #5B82FF. Never recolour the standard files by hand.
usage.loading: Use mark_animated as a scanning / working state while a scan is in flight. It loops on a 3s cycle and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
usage.browser_tab: favicon_svg plus favicon_ico. Sizes 16 and 32 use a two-row cut of the mark because three rows blur together below 32px.
usage.readme: readme_banner at the top of a README. Use a STATIC file there — GitHub strips SVG styling, so an animated SVG will not animate in a README.
usage.animation_support: The animated SVGs loop anywhere real CSS runs (Vercel, Framer, any browser). They do NOT animate inside a GitHub README.
usage.stacked: Use logo_stacked where the lockup has vertical room and limited width - footers, app splash, square placements.

rules: Two colours only: black #000000 and blue #1B4DFF on white, or the inverse files on black. Do not introduce a third colour.
Blue is for the brackets only. Never recolour the rows or the wordmark blue, and never render the brackets in anything but #1B4DFF.
On dark grounds use the -inverse files, which carry blue #5B82FF. Never place the white-ground blue #1B4DFF on near-black.
Never recolour, add gradients, shadows, glows, or outlines.
Never re-typeset the wordmark in live text — always use the outlined path.
Never rearrange the lockup: the mark sits left of the word, at the spacing defined in build-brand.py.
Clear space on all sides is at least one bracket height (36 units at the mark's 64-unit viewBox, i.e. 56% of the mark's height).
Minimum sizes: 16px using the favicon cut, 32px for the three-row mark, 120px for the full lockup.
Below 32px always use the two-row favicon cut — the three-row mark turns to mush.
SVGs are the source of truth; PNGs are derived. Never hand-edit either — change the geometry and re-run the build.
The 38% opacity on the mark's middle row is part of the mark, not a styling choice.

regenerate.requirements: Wordmark extraction needs network access and fonttools. The main build needs nothing to write SVGs; PNG output additionally needs headless Chromium and Pillow, and degrades gracefully without them.
regenerate.note: wordmark.path is committed, so the normal build never touches the network.
